review_candidates.title: Quality specialist Telecom industry (B2/C1)
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Description The Quality Specialist in the Telecom industry at Xceed is responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and enhancing the quality of customer interactions and processes across telecom-related operations. The position requires maintaining accurate records, adhering to industry regulations, and actively participating in initiatives aimed at improving the overall customer experience.
eligibility_evidence: Xceed holds multiple international certifications, including COPC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 22301, and ISO/IEC 27001, reflecting its commitment to quality, security, and business continuity.

This full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt includes reviewing calls and tickets, analyzing performance data, conducting audits, and providing structured feedback to ensure compliance with client and internal standards.
Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced on-site environment.
